hypothesis: Use actual within-episode movement failure to revise the next action, then compress completed-episode movement evidence for conditional reuse. Separate immediate reaction from cross-episode memory; no reward change or imaginary outcomes.

intervention.wake: After at least two consecutive stationary transitions, defer a greedy proposed normal action already observed stationary at this same location/context. Rank the remaining legal actions by the existing learner scores; epsilon exploration is unchanged. Dashes are not given unobserved outcomes.
intervention.sleep: Store per-completed-episode moved/stalled evidence for each 3x3 observed road pattern, buff status and normal action. Following a captured episode, consolidate a conditional rule only with at least two distinct episodes of stalling, zero episodes of movement for that action, and at least two episodes of movement for some alternative. Any observed movement contradicts/revokes the stalled belief. All arms record/aggregate the same audit memory; only full variants read it for action.
intervention.scope: Local movement feasibility, not causal attribution of capture or a permanent prohibition. All16 legal actions remain accessible via epsilon; no penalties or changed rewards. Hand-designed correction criterion is an explicit prior, not emergent general reflection.
intervention.sleep_implementation: External episodic memory consolidation, not Sleep paper weight distillation/MoE/RL reward or full Dream-RSI policy-code search. No new parameter update besides ordinary baseline learning.
intervention.terminal: Only observed completed episodes are merged. Failure triggers rule construction; success contributes ordinary factual memory and contradiction removal, not diagnostic calls. Partial tails are not treated as terminal.
intervention.evaluation: Frozen parameters, replay and cross-episode memory. Fresh local working memory may react within each evaluation episode; no evaluation evidence enters later evaluation episodes or training.
